scripts.test:p2:db:down: npm run test:p2:db:env && docker compose -f docker-compose.p2-test.yml down -v

scripts.test:p3:auth-security-db: npm run test:p2:db:up && P2_TEST_DATABASE_REQUIRED=true P2_TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL="$(node scripts/p2-test-db-env.mjs --print-admin-url)" npm run test:p2:api-authz-db

scripts.test:db:migrate-replay: npm run test:p2:db:up && P2_TEST_DATABASE_REQUIRED=true P2_TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL="$(node scripts/p2-test-db-env.mjs --print-admin-url)" npm --prefix backend run test:db:migrate-replay
